name: Predicting the running time of bioinformatics tools

mentions.name: Predicting the running time of bioinformatics tools
mentions.description: A master's thesis project in bioinformatics/HPC that predicts the running time of bioinformatics tools by running five tools 1000 times each with different parameters and then fitting a curve, targeting around 70% prediction rates plus or minus 10%.
